title: Shell guards pass deliberate shapes beside the mistakes they block
when: A Bash command runs rg with a replacement, or curl against port 8765.
need: rg -r with a $ capture replacement (rg -o PAT -r '$1' FILES) rewrites printed output and passes; rg -rn PAT, the grep-style recursive mistake, is still refused with an rg -n repair. curl is refused only on Yoke API paths (/v1, /api) at localhost, 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0 port 8765, or through $YOKE_API; a local static file server on 8765 passes.
review: Source regression cases cover each passing shape and each still-refused shape on both hook paths for rg. Live installed delivery remains unverified.
